# Bosch Origify

> > Origify by Bosch Secure Authentication provides markerless surface microstructure technology for product authentication, anti-counterfeiting, and supply chain security across luxury, high-security, and manufacturing markets.

Founded by Steinbis and Hachenberger with roots in Bosch innovation, Origify offers SDK integration (including Flutter plugins), white-label mobile apps, and NFC-based Digital Product Passport (DPP) solutions. The platform serves enterprises fighting counterfeiting through OECD-aligned authenticity verification without requiring additional markers or tags.

## Key Topics

- Product Authentication
- Markerless Authentication Technology
- Anti-Counterfeiting Solutions
- Brand Protection
- Supply Chain Security
- Origify SDK & Flutter Plugin
- NFC & Digital Product Passport (DPP)
- Luxury Market Authentication
- High-Security Document Verification
- Surface Microstructure Technology
- Trademark Infringement Prevention
- Reverse Engineering Protection
- Sustainability & Authenticity
- White-Label Mobile Apps
- OECD & EUIPO Standards
